title: Move thinker view-function filter calibration
summary: value_flow on Move was firing on balance_value() read-only functions. Added _is_move_view_function() heuristic: detect read-only via no &mut params + no entry modifier + no mutation operations in body (transfer::, ::join, ::split, push_back, remove, borrow_mut, .add). Result on Astros perp_vault: 8 to 6 hypotheses (25 percent FP cut), 100 percent signal rate (1 REAL ASTROSSC-290 + 5 KNOWN catalogued, zero FPs).
key_lesson: Move view-function detection requires body inspection because Move has no view/pure keyword. Heuristic: NO &mut param, NO entry modifier, NO mutation primitives in body. Same calibration pattern as Solidity boundary_prober view filter that cut Dexalot 81 percent. Calibration depth on Move: ~70 percent of Solidity, sufficient for production use on bounty/contest workflow.
